Beyond Meat (BYND) finally releases its delayed earnings report after the closing bell today sending its shares higher in the premarket. Guinness and Johnnie Walker maker Diageo's (DGE.L) London listed shares got a boost after appointing a new CEO. Rumble (RUM) shares are spiking in the premarket too after media reports said that the firm that hosts President Trump's Truth social platform is looking to buy German AI cloud company, Northern Data (NB2.DE).
